$comment: Generated by `cargo test` (crates/chimaera-server/src/ws.rs); do not edit by hand. The Rust test pins these shapes, the web-ui Vitest consumer tests read them. Regenerate: run the Rust tests without CHIMAERA_WIRE_FIXTURES=check, then commit the result.
about: /ws/sessions/{id} text frames (ws::frames): ready, resync, the SessionEvent frames, exited, and the errors. Each ready/resync is followed by the snapshot as one binary frame.

cases.name: ready
cases.note: attach accepted: the SessionInfo fields plus cwd_current (the polled cwd)

cases.name: ready_last_words
cases.note: a session that died before the attach: its final screen replays, then `exited`

cases.name: resync
cases.note: repaint at this grid; the next binary frame is the snapshot

cases.name: shell_phase
cases.note: OSC 133 shell phase (the client reads phase from session rows; this frame is informational)

cases.name: exited_event
cases.note: the child exited, as the session's own event

cases.name: exited
cases.note: the daemon's own exited frame after a last-words replay

cases.name: exited_unknown
cases.note: the session is gone with no status

cases.name: error_unauthorized
cases.note: bad first frame: the socket closes
